temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in some trouble and has been hiding it; Christian is worried and concerned.

temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may have been involved with the wrong people and possibly criminal trouble; Christian is investigating discreetly.

temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unidentified person; Christian is gathering evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; the real culprit is identified as someone close to and trusted by both Christian and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The real culprit is a trusted person close to both of them; this person framed Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice, ensuring the betrayal does not go unpunished while being careful.
